description: A shell script that defines and executes various tests for git reset functionality, including setup, reset, reset HEAD, reset specific files, reset with patch, soft reset, and hard reset.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given file/path is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within output.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific file/directory is missing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Executes commands upon test completion for cleanup.
